title: Cell Painting screen of 5259 SPECS compounds in U2OS cells
goal: Generate morphological profiles (CellProfiler features, grit scores, radar charts, t-SNE) for 5259 compounds on U2OS cells so that compounds with similar morphology to JQ1, I-BET151, Vemurafenib, Crizotinib and Panobinostat can be identified.
